paper_title: EssayBench Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Genre Chinese   Essay Writing
caption: Dataset Statistics. Note that Open denotes Open-Ended sets, Cons. refers to Constrained sets.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна и показва сравнение на 'Sample Count' за различни видове текстове. Хоризонталната ос представлява категориите текстове, които са подредени по азбучен ред: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive и Expository. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Sample Count" и показва стойностите на скала, започваща от 0 и достигаща 130, с равномерни интервали от 10. За всеки тип текст има два стълба, които представляват два типа комплекти, обозначени в легендата като "Open" и "Cons." (Constrained). Срещу Argumentative, стойността на стълба "Open" е 79, а стойността на стълба "Cons." е 80. За Narrative, стълбовете показват съответно 87 и 68. За Descriptive, стойностите са 100 и 62, а за Expository – 122 и 130. Някои стълбове са засенчени в различни нюанси на синьо и розово, в съответствие със заглавията в легендата.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of data across four categories within two groupings. The horizontal axis displays the categories "Argumentative," "Narrative," "Descriptive," and "Expository," presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Sample Count" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 130, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart presents paired bars for each category, representing "Open" and "Cons." sets. The "Cons." bars are displayed in a pink shade, while the "Open" bars are depicted in a light blue shade. The shortest "Cons." bar, corresponding to the "Descriptive" category, has an approximate value of 62, while the tallest "Cons." bar, associated with the "Open" data in the "Narrative" category, extends to approximately 130. The "Open" bars range in height from approximately 79 for the “Argumentative” category to approximately 122 for the “Narrative” category. The “Cons.” bars range from approximately 68 for the “Descriptive” category, to approximately 100 for the "Argumentative" category. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color distinction representing the two groupings.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Stichprobengrößen verschiedener Datensatztypen in einem chinesischen Aufsatzkorpus. Auf der horizontalen Achse sind vier Kategorien dargestellt: Argumentative, Narrative, Deskriptive und Expository. Jede dieser Kategorien hat zwei zugehörige Balken: einen blassblauen Balken, der mit "Open" gekennzeichnet ist, und einen hellrosa Balken, der mit "Cons." gekennzeichnet ist. Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Sample Count" beschriftet und skaliert von 0 bis 130 in Schritten von 10, wobei die Werte in Einheiten der Stichprobengröße dargestellt werden. Der blaue Balken für Argumentative hat einen Wert von 79, der hellrosa Balken für Argumentative einen Wert von 122. Der blaue Balken für Narrative hat einen Wert von 80, der hellrosa Balken für Narrative einen Wert von 87. Der blaue Balken für Deskriptive hat einen Wert von 68, der hellrosa Balken für Deskriptive einen Wert von 100. Der blaue Balken für Expository hat einen Wert von 62, der hellrosa Balken für Expository einen Wert von 130. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, und keine der Balken wurden visuell hervorgehoben.
